purpose: Teach: 至急/台帳/雇い/シンクタンク/区民/区内/チームワーク/不明確

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 至急、本気で、絶対、ご対応、絶対、いただきたい、絶対、件があります
lines.en: I need you to handle this urgently — and I'm serious about it.
lines.style: Clipped, direct opening. Business-like pace. Slight lift on the request — not commanding, but clear this is priority. Eyes steady.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経理の、本気で、絶対、台帳、絶対、確認、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. I'll verify the accounting ledger right away.
lines.style: Prompt, attentive. Slight nod in the voice. Professional but warm — showing readiness without overdoing it. Efficient tempo.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 専門人材の、本気で、絶対、雇い入れ、絶対、来期、絶対、進めましょうか
lines.en: Should we move forward with bringing in specialist talent for next term?
lines.style: Measured, opening with genuine curiosity. Slight questioning lilt on the closing — inviting agreement, not assuming it. Thoughtful pause weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経営戦略の、本気で、絶対、シンクタンク、絶対、当社、絶対、契約、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've already contracted with the strategy think tank for management consulting.
lines.style: Factual, reassuring. Light emphasis on 「already」 — showing initiative taken. Steady, professional tone. No rush, but clear and complete.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社の、本気で、絶対、区民、絶対、向けキャンペーン、絶対、好評ですね
lines.en: The campaign we launched for residents has been doing really well.
lines.style: Warm uptick at the start. Genuine pleased tone — not performed enthusiasm, but real satisfaction. Light pace. Trailing brightness on the close.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。区内、本気で、絶対、店舗、絶対、ネットワーク、絶対、拡大、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively expanding our store network throughout the ward.
lines.style: Steady, progress-focused. Even tempo. Subtle emphasis on 「expanding」 showing momentum. Professional warmth — reporting good news without overstatement.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 部署間の、本気で、絶対、チームワーク、絶対、強化、絶対、研修、絶対、企画しましょう
lines.en: Let's design a training program to strengthen collaboration between departments.
lines.style: Suggesting with quiet confidence. Opening decisive, closing inclusive — 「let's」 draws them in. Moderate pace. Forward-moving energy without pressure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。指示が、本気で、絶対、不明確、絶対、な点、絶対、再確認、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Of course. I'll double-check any points where the instructions might be unclear.
lines.style: Attentive, humble. Light self-check — admitting ambiguity is normal. Steady, closing tone. The reassurance that details matter and will be handled well.
